sentences.text:

 Versus
The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
Shri Abhishek Singh - Government Advocate for the State.

Order 
This petition is filed seeking a direction to the concerned respondent/Collector to decide the application under 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 within some prescribed time period.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: This innocuous prayer is not opposed by Shri Abhishek Singh, learned Government Advocate.

Accordingly, this petition can be disposed of that in case, petitioner files a fresh representation along with a certified copy of this order before respondent no. 1 Collector, District Chhatarpur within a period of fifteen days from today, the said authority shall decide the representation of the petitioner through a speaking order within a further period of sixty days.
In above terms, the petition is disposed of.
This Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
